Name: Sewer Minecart
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]Just adds a minecart destination outside the forest entrance to the Sewer. Meant to be used with other mods that expand the minecart network, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21859]More Minecarts[/url], but can technically be used on its own.[/size]

[size=3]Probably not compatible with mods that significantly change this area of the map, and no compatibility will be provided. Feel free to make your own mods for that.[/size]

[size=4][b]Self-promotion[/b][/size]
[size=3]Do you like expanding vanilla mechanics? Try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53570]More Treasure Totems[/url]![/size]

Manifest.Name: Sewer Minecart
Manifest.Description: Adds a minecart near the forest sewer entrance.
Manifest.Author: Suntooth
